Module 1:  Agency, education and innovation (1 hour)

Position of the majority of young [sex of FGD] on the ladder of power and freedom (private rating): 5 = Power and freedom to make almost all major life decisions: 0 votes; 4 = Power and freedom to make many major life decisions: 1 vote; 3 = Power and freedom to make some major life decisions: 6 votes; 2 = Only a small amount of power and freedom: 1 vote; 1 = Almost no power or freedom to make decisions: 1 vote

The women in our village cannot take all the decisions by themselves but now as the education till 8th grade is mandatory few of their opinions get accepted. They can take few of the decisions as they are getting educated. So we think that most of the girls are in the 3rd stage of this ladder. The girls in our village can only take 25% of their decisions by themselves & rest are on the parents. They can never decide about their marriage. There are some girls in our village who cannot take any of their decisions & for that you can see few votes in the 1st& 2nd stage. The reason behind not being able to take decisions is they are not educated. Also there are few girls who can take all their decisions in life because they are educated, confident & employed. They can do anything they want. These women live their life by teaching, doing business etc. Though the number of this kind of women is pretty low. Most of the girls are in the 3rd stage due to lack of education & employment. So at the end they need to be dependent on their parents or in laws or husband.

To us education is really important because it gives the edge to decide your profession. Education gives the power to dwell in the society with respect. Education can make people confident & dynamic. An uneducated person finds it hard to live in the society. So we think that kids should go to the schools for getting educated. A girl should get education because a mother can decide the betterment of her children. A educated mother can give her children a better future.

Education is necessary because if you look at the society you will see how people value the words of a educated mother & neglect the uneducated one’s. People do not get the proper respect without education. Our parents were not educated enough so they couldn’t make us educated enough. If they would have been educated enough we could have gotten a better life. Education is so valuable that a nation’s future depends on it. If there is a educated wife in the family then she can direct the family to better future even if her husband is unable to earn. An uneducated wife can never do that. A educated wife can assure the future of the family in the absence of her husband which an uneducated wife cannot do very easily. The women without education have to work like a labor to help out her family in hard times. So we think education is really important.

The boys in our village study only till SSC. But most of the males study only till tenth grade. Some couldn’t pass even after attending the SSC exam. A few who pass out study more. The girls of our village also study till HSC maximum, some study till HSC.

According to us everyone should get equal education. Boys should do it till honours or masters to get a good job. On the other hand girls should study till HSC so that they can do something on their own. Because except HSC a girl cannot even join a job.

Nowadays all the parents in our village think almost the same about educating their children. Previously parents were stricter about educating their children. Though the situation is quite changed now. Because now girls are interested to study. Also a educated girl can be easily married. In here parents want to educate their boys but guys are less intend to get educated so they leave schools earlier.

In our village girls do farming, dairy activities, poultry etc. Also they do boiling paddy, threshing, tree plantations etc. How to take care of the crops like paddy, wheat, jute, they learn up all this in early age.
Women do tree plantation, gardening, poultry, taking care of domestic animals. As now girls do study they are less intend to do farming. They only do to help their parents.
Reasons for ending education
Two most important reasons

The girls leave study earlier due to family issues, monetary problem. Sometimes parents married their daughter early. Parents often do not feel the importance of education so they do not educate their daughter. Most of the parents think that what will a girl with education does as she will not earn for her parents. So for the betterment they married their girl off to her in laws. Often the local goons irritate them while going to school so the parents of the girls stop her from going to school. For all these reason the girls of our village leave their education.

1. Monetary issues is the first reason for the girls to leave their education. Only because the parents do not have money causes them to stop the education of their daughter. 2. Not all parents do it for the monetary reasons. Some solvent parents also married their girl off. After that they have to stop their education. Because if they get a good groom they get interested to marry her off earlier.
People are intending to work after their education & I also do that. I want to be a teacher after finishing off my education. I want to share what I have learned.

I want to be a teacher because this is the best profession for the girls of present days. Another respondent say she wants to manage her own boutique shop. For the past 4 years she has been managing it. I want to make this shop bigger & let other women work in here. Another respondent wants to be a doctor so that she can take care of people. My family also supports me in this matter. The next one also wants to be a doctor & help the poor patient of the village. My family couldn’t get me the education because of their monetary issues. I wanted to be a nurse after finishing of my study. My father couldn’t educate me also due to our poverty & I never had the time to decide that what I want to be. I also haven’t decided that what I can be after my studies though I am continuing it. I will do a job maybe. I couldn’t get education because I was married off. Still I wanted to do engineering from polytechnic college.

The village girls married off & leave their studies. They cannot continue it due to the interest of their In laws. Here, the ones who already left education but unmarried do poultry & other activities at home. Educated girls often do sewing.

We believe to get the confidence a girl should work after her studies. She can do so many things like farming, gardening, sewing etc. Basically a girl can do things to earn after her education which is better.

In last 5 years we have been introduced with so many farming technologies. We saw a machine which can seed & plough the land at the same time, mainly work for wheat cultivation. For thrashing wheat there is also a machine. Which was not available 5 years back. In our village now there are farming related trainings are being arranged though the young women like us cannot join those the guys are more frequent in these trainings. There are so many new seeds for wheat cultivation. The seeds are bari wheat 24, 27, 28, 52, prodip wheat etc. We have also got a technology through which we can creat compost fertilizer with earthworms. Before getting the seeding machine for wheat we had to seed the field manually but now we can do it with the machines through which it saves time & effort. Now we have another machine attached to the plow which can create drain through the soil while cultivating & seeding. This technology is quite new in our village.

Most important two practices for the women: 1. The most important for the women is the thrashing machine for wheat. Because women are the one who do it. Manually thrashing the crops takes too much time & effort. 2. Another important thing which is happening for the women is the arrival of modern seeds. Previously the seeds were tending to get infected so easily. Also they were supposed to dry in the sun again & again which was really hard to do. But now as they have better & hybrid seeds these bad things do not happen. Most important two practices for the men: 1. The most important thing for the men is the training. The trainings can make them better farmers. These can make them know how to use the new technologies. They can also know how to grow better crops in bigger amount. So training is the most important for the guys. 2. The seeding machine for wheat because earlier they had to do it manually & which was way too hard for them. Now with this machine you can seed the whole field equally. The harvest is also coming in great amount.

In our village the girls also try to know the wheat cultivation process so that they can help out their family. They intend to extract information/ practices /knowledge about farming. But they do not get the chance much. It is because the training do not call the young aged girls. The young girls do not do farming as they say. Mostly the cultivation of wheat is a guy thing to do. Though in all the other training related to farming call the girls. The girls can also go there with the boys, their husbands. HSC graduated girls have got a training from USAID on cultivating sweet potato. They don’t call the school girls as the girls cannot go due to their study.
Module 2.  Gender norms, livelihoods, and family formation (1 ½ hours)

The most important practices in our village in terms of wheat cultivation are, training the farmers, cultivating with seeder machine in drainage system, use of hybrid seeds. For all these three reason the production went higher. 10 years back women used to thrash the wheat manually by using their hands but now we have the machine for doing that. Back then it was really a hard job to do. 10 years back women had to extract the seeds from their own wheat. But now as we have better seeds they do not need to do it. We also have now the harvesting machine for cutting wheat plants which saves a lot of time & effort.
Important wheat innovation for [sex of FGD] Now
Important wheat innovation for [sex of FGD] Ten years ago

In last ten years the agricultural scenario developed a lot in here. Behind these developments the reason is that there are so many groups working as USAID, Social development committee etc. Also new technologies are making people interested to try out farming again. The works are getting easier so people are liking it. Nowadays all the people have TV in their houses, also the transport system developed. Farmers can easily go to the city & collect necessary things. Because of these reasons farming got better in recent days.

In here our people follow different tasks allocated for guys & ladies in farming. Like planting the trees, seeds are mainly done by the males. Boiling the paddy, drying up etcare done by the ladies. From the bery early age we are seeing that males work in the fields & women work at home. So that is how the mindset built. None ever told us not to go to the fields but as we grew up seeing that it became the normal thing. Some of the women do work in the fields who are too much miserable/poor.

If a guy needs to earn money by farming they can easily do it & sell them in the markets which women cannot easily do. The students only work with their parents/family, they never work alone. If they want to do alone they can do it too.

It is not easier for women to earn money by doing their own farming, growing crops & selling it in the market. The society would not take it very nicely. She can only sell her crops if the buyer comes home to buy them. Women do not go to the market because the society does not call it a good thing to do. It is normal for the guys to go there and dwell around. On the other hand women are also shy to go there. People will call a woman bad if they see her there. The norms of the society are the main barriers to do it.
There is no such rule in our village to farm selective lands by selective people. Every family farm their own lands.
Men & women do not have separate lands . Most of the lands are registered on the names of the husbands. When they want they can farm their lands together. Women work at home & men work in the fields.
During the harvesting time the whole family may work in the fields. The male members of the family work in the fields & the women work at home.
If a woman shows the interest to learn farming and take training then she has to discuss with her husband first then she can go to the organizations
Men discuss with the senior farmers or the officers if they intend to know anything. They do not much value the words of their wives.
Rafiq will not let her go as he thinks the earning responsibility only stays to him. He will not let her join any group. They do not let their wives join different association.
Men say they will manage other persons to go to the market for selling the goods rather than letting their wives join the associations.
Later if nasima denies to obey him that will drive to serious conflict.
If nasima wants to go to the market to sell her own vegetables then conflict may arise.
Rafiq will not let Nasima go, if she does world war may occur.

If women show their stubbornness about something then divorce might happen. Even after all these if Nasima shows her interest about going to the market then rafiq might question her character. Rafiq will also say i do not want crops which my wife needs to sell in the market.
As rafiq does not want her to earn her own money he will tell her to get done with his work first. He will not seek other assistance from her.

Wives cannot go to the market to sell their own grown crops as the society will not take it easily. They will call the guy lazy and will blame him to make his wife working outside. This will disrespect the family & hamper the reputation according to village rules/social norms.
People will start teasing.Though the intention of selling vegetables in the market is good for Mala & her family, the society will not remain happy with this.
Monir will be losing his reputation among people, his friends will not give him proper value.

As the thing might get better for monir if mala goes to the market, he can rest himself but the society will not be taking it normally.Monir friends will be teasing him “ Your wife works outside & you lay idly at home”

It could be a great news if both the husband & wife prosper together but this will not be good according to the society.Even Monir might be happy with the progress of Mala but other people in the society will give it a different tagline.Though the society will always blabber bad things.

Equality is having the balance of rights among the men & women. For example: in education, workplace etc. As the women are also getting educated now we have equality there. Every human isn’t equal. Everyone is different in their own ways. Some are more intelligent than others, some are half way through intelligence. Carrying on the life without a minimum level of intelligence is quite difficult. The family relies on their base of intelligence. They both (Husband-Wife) earn together, manage their income towards the development of the family. Women should be able to visit the market, do their parts normally. That is how equality can be assured. We think without equality progress is not possible. Our national poet KaziNazrul Islam, Begum rokeya also talked about equality.
No women can decide alone. The women in our village cannot take decisions alone, both husband & wife need to agree to make up their mind on something.
Fatima & faruk both will discuss on this together. [Everyone agrees]
Fatima cannot take the decision alone.All them said both of them should discuss & reach to the decision together.They both can take the decision of the garden together.

The vegetables will be sold by faruk because the villagers will not take things easily if they see Fatima is in the market to sell. People will criticize if she goes there. So it needs to get done by faruk. Also the easier faruk will be able to carry the vegetables to the market, Fatima will not me able to do it that easy.
If the way or new process looks profitable then of course they will do it. This will be for their own betterment. They both will discuss & decide. It will get importance because the profit will rise.
They will discuss upon this & if this year they cannot do it the next year they will.

According to us if she wants to buy land on her own it will be pretty tough for her. Faruk will disagree. Even if the money belongs to her if she spends it anyway he might get angry. I think Fatima will not let his but the motorcycle, because the bike will not be in any development of the family. If they buy lands with that money then it might come as a useful decision. So we think even if he doesn’t agree about the land she will insist to buy that.
The women do not feel comfortable walking in the market because men say weird bad syuffs to women. They feel uncomfortable. Also the villagers do not think god about it.
The married girls never go to the market. They cannot do it at all as people criticize. Before marriage it is possible to go with parents or friends.
No, women cannot sell things in the market because it is not natural here. People say bad things about women who do that. This is the work which should remain to the males.

Out of every 10 women, how many move freely on their own in public spaces (private rating): 1 (practically no women move freely on their own in the village): 1 vote; 2: 0 votes; 3: 3 votes; 4: 0 votes; 5: 2 votes; 6: 2 votes; 7: 0 votes; 8: 1 vote; 9: 0 votes; 10 (practically all women move freely on their own in the village): 0 votes (Total 9 votes)

Because women cannot roam alone in the village as the parents or in laws do not let them do it. Beside if ant harm comes to the girl so they do not let her do it. But the girls who got education till SSC can go as parents do not let them before SSC. They go to the college alone & often to the market. After afternoon the girls or women do not go anywhere. So it is quite like that. Some girls do go to college alone but the number is pretty low.

Very few women go out of the village to work. The percentage is around 4-5%. The parents or in laws never let them go outside the village. So that they cannot easily migrate. They always get tensed for their daughters. also they get tensed because if the girls go & get married alone. The parents will loose reputation. Some of the widowed & poor women did go outside of the village to work. Even if they come back clean people will talk bad things about them.

If a girl comes back leaving the city the society will still call bad things on her name, they will not take it easily. Moreover if a girl gets healthier they say worse things. People will not ready to believe that she did something decent to earn the money. Then she will find it hard to work in the village. She will not feel comfortable.
Here a guy gets married at the age of 24-25. Most of the girls get married in 18. Because parents do not marry off their girl before 18.

The parents decide who will the boy or girl marry. First the parents of the groom see girls to get their son married, if they like the girl then the bride’s family visit the groom’s house. Here most of the marriages are happening within relatives. Generally the opinion of the bride doesn’t much matter in terms of getting her married. The parents take the decision for her.

We think both the boy and girl should get agree to get married. Parents should listen to their opinion. They should like each other before passing the entire life together. Also parents should know whether they want to study more or not. They should also think if the bride or groom is underage.

In here women tend to get babies within a year of their marriage. This means they do it in 19 years. Some of the girls get married in 14 years. A guy comes up suddenly with money from abroad who is 330 marries a girl who is 24 & leaves when his wife is pregnant.
We think it is okay giving birth at 19 but its better if they do it in 20-22. Because then the body becomes able to take a baby.

It should be after 20 years because there are so many risk if they take if before that. Often the baby & the mother die together. If a woman gets successful to do it still they face physical barriers later. They feel weaker.

Both the husband & wife decide that when & how many babies they are going to take. The workers who help people to plan their families come over for discussions. In some families the elders influence to take babies so they often get influenced by that. Though no women can take decisions alone on their own.

We need our daughters to get good education. To get facilities through which they can get better in life. No eve teasing during the school time also. Also we need them to learn different hand works. So that they can earn when they are studying. There are families who do not want to spend money for education of girls, we want them to change their minds. They should not marry off their girls too early. In here the boys often get addicted to different drugs. We want to get rid of these things. They smoke marijuana, takes yaba etc. We want the government to create employment for the males so that they can earn & get into a better life. Also we want our girls to take their own decisions.
